visual_identity.core_identity: A tall long-armed shaggy goblinoid ambush predator: imposing and hairy, but unmistakably goblinoid rather than ape, sasquatch, bear, or generic brute.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall broad-shouldered humanoid with disproportionately long arms, large hands, slightly hunched predatory posture, pointed ears, and shaggy hair concentrated around head, shoulders, forearms, and back.
visual_identity.head_features: Heavy goblinoid face with broad flattened nose, low brow, deep-set eyes, pointed ears, pronounced cheek structure, and a short goblinoid muzzle area rather than an ape muzzle.
visual_identity.body_shape: Powerful long-limbed humanoid with broad shoulders and long reach; muscular but not bodybuilder-thick, with forward-leaning stealth posture.
visual_identity.surface: Coarse shaggy hair in controlled patches; chest, face, hands, and major anatomy stay readable. Never a full-body sasquatch coat.

accuracy_checks: arms are visibly longer than normal humanoid arms
pointed ears remain readable through hair
fur supports silhouette without hiding anatomy
posture reads ambush predator rather than portrait model

known_failure_modes.symptom: creature reads as Bigfoot or sasquatch
known_failure_modes.correction: reduce full-body fur, restore pointed goblinoid ears and broad flattened goblinoid nose, strengthen scavenged gear and ambush posture
remove primate muzzle and knuckle-walking cues; restore humanoid torso, goblinoid face, and long-armed upright ambusher anatomy
remove bear muzzle and rounded bear ears; restore pointed ears and goblinoid facial planes
use a forward lean, crouch, concealment, or active ambush gesture
